scientific_integrity: Exact reachable-state traversal and two deterministic minimization algorithms; nonoverlap semantics tested separately on all words of lengths 0 through 9. The theorem also relies on a proved streaming-state invariant and the classical Myhill-Nerode theorem.
scientific_limitations: Four-letter Watson-Crick alphabet; linear, unconstrained-length words; two-base stem; nonoverlap without additional loop separation; complete deterministic one-pass DFA. Does not concern optimal DNA code rate, longer stems, or biochemical folding.
title: The exact 7,311-state complexity of dinucleotide secondary-structure avoidance
